ns2:section.sectionText: Analyzing Politics This course provides an undergraduate level introduction to formal (mathematical) models of politics. We will use insights from social choice theory and game theory to examine how various political institutions or their absence affect the interaction between voters, parties, leaders, and countries. Some of the topics we will cover are: social choice, electoral/party politics, collective action, political accountability, bargaining and conflict, and credible commitment. No mathematical background required.
